Third-party libraries (bundled so barcode / QR labels work offline):
- JsBarcode 3.12.3 (MIT) - https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode
- qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT) - https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- ZXing (@zxing/library 0.21.3, Apache-2.0) - https://github.com/zxing-js/library  (zxing.min.js: camera barcode / QR decoding, bundled so the scanner works offline)
